broken.said: Judge only the packet's current validation of vector pop state. It rejects a pop that clears the final live slot but incorrectly keeps the old logical length. A list conversion that drops None slots cannot detect that defect: the packet also checks the decremented logical length independently of the filtered values. Accepting that stale-length pop, or claiming filtered list equality establishes correct logical length, breaks this rule. A historical missed defect is allowed if the packet shows its corrected length check now rejects the same candidate. For a range/read-only packet, explicit logical bounds and rejection of length inferred from filtered values satisfy this rule. Judge the observations, not the packet's clean/broken label.
